sources.verified: PSP-110 published approximately 52 × 12.5 × 36 mm excluding projections,3.6 V / 1800 mAh. Installed model axes are 36 × 52 × 12.5 mm. Sony also specifies Memory Stick Duo 20 × 1.6 × 31 mm, unchanged existing accessory.
Original PSP-1000 HPRM location, Memory Stick side entry, HOLD mechanical indicator that appears yellow in locked state. Model uses unlocked dark indicator.
Original remote mating connector has six pins; original hardware experimentation, not later PSP-2000 video interface.
Headphone/remote interface diagram: two rows of three remote pins next to 3.5 mm headphone jack.
Orange Memory Stick access indicator described in hardware LED replacement guide. RGB values are illustrative, not measured chromaticity.

changes.basis: Sony approximate external battery specification. Corner radius 12 mm, cell cavity and rim are estimated.

Restore 6 contacts in 2 rows and open mating mouth. Local pitch and contact proportions estimated.
Orange Memory Stick access display and previously absent HOLD flag. Indicator size/placement fitted.
